=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: "Run read-profile commands in an OS-enforced read-only sandbox without writable access to support files, and verify support-script integrity immediately before execution." and the related protection from the issue: "A read-profile model may have seen untrusted source. ... Protect all host-side read-profile roles by restricting dangerous commands and preventing writes to trusted support files."
  Expected change site: scripts/claude_engine.py:606 in `substitute()` (the line that registers the Bash PreToolUse hook) and the call site that wires the new `guard-read-bash` subcommand into production; the pre-existing `cmd_read_guard` path is the only one actually invoked in production.
  Evidence of absence: scripts/claude_engine.py:606 renders the Bash hook command as `f'python3 "{read_guard_path}" {"read-guard" if read_guard_hook is not None else READ_GUARD_SUBCOMMAND}'`. In `cmd_settings` at line 1191 `read_guard_hook=args.read_guard_hook or str(Path(__file__).resolve())` always returns a non-None string (defaults to the engine's own path), and scripts/ai_engine.sh:311 unconditionally passes `--read-guard-hook /read-guard.py` to the isolated `settings` call, so every production `render_settings(profile="read")` evaluates the truthy branch and emits `python3 "<path>" read-guard` rather than `python3 "<path>" guard-read-bash`. The newly added `read_bash_denial` parser — the only place that actually rejects `git show --output=…`, `git diff --ext-diff/--textconv`, `git grep -O`, and shell-expansion forms like `git show $(id)` — is therefore dead code in production. The original linked exploit `git show --output=../scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh HEAD:scripts/review_single_issue_security_pass.sh` would still be admitted by the still-active `cmd_read_guard` path. The new test at tests/test_claude_settings_policy.py:90-93 only exercises `_render(profile="read")` without `read_guard_hook`, so it does not catch this wiring mistake.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
